thread:
Ryan_Customer: Hey team — after the ~09:00 rollout yesterday our app is seeing broken markdown from the API. Customers get stray ``` fences and sometimes an extra backtick at the end of code blocks. Example response (from model `redwood-v2-small`):

```
Here is the example:
```
function example() {
  console.log('hello');
}
```

But the API returns: `
Here is the example:
```
function example() {
  console.log('hello');
}
```
`
(note the extra surrounding backticks and sometimes an extra single ` following the block). This breaks our markdown renderer. We never changed prompt or stop sequences. Ticket #CS-8712. Anyone else seeing this?

Marta: Thanks for the report — assigning to us. :eyes: Can you paste the exact API request payload + response headers (request_id if available)? Also which SDK / API version?

Ryan_Customer: Sure — using curl to the hosted API (lib in prod is our wrapper):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-v2-small",
    "input": "Generate a small JS example in markdown fenced code",
    "max_tokens": 120,
    "stop": ["\n---\n"]
  }'
```

Response body (truncated):
```
{"id":"resp_abc123","object":"generation","model":"redwood-v2-small","output":"\nHere is the example:\n```\nfunction example() {\n  console.log('hello');\n}\n```\n`"}
```

Headers: `x-request-id: req_20250322_999`, `x-runtime-version: runtime-3.4.1-release`

Sophie: That's very helpful — adding notes to the thread. Two quick questions: 1) Did the problematic outputs start immediately after the rollout time? 2) Do you ever see missing closing fences (i.e., an unclosed ```)?

Ryan_Customer: Yes started within ~5m after the 09:00 deploy. We have both symptoms: sometimes extra fencing (as shown) and in a few flows the closing fence is missing and the remainder of the doc is treated as code. It's intermittent (~2-3% of gen calls).

DeployBot: Deployment notice: rollout `deploy_20250322_v3` promoted at 2025-03-22T09:02:12Z by `release-team`. Components touched: `tokenizer-config`, `runtime-compiler` (patch id: fc3a9).

Carlos: tagging eng-runtime / eng-ml to triage. Quick hypothesis: the `tokenizer-config` change in the rollout included a small normalization tweak (strip trailing whitespace) that might affect stop sequence matching and fence delimiting when the model emits raw backticks. If stop matching shifts by one token, you can get leading/trailing stray backticks. Can we get the raw tokens around the fence for the failing request?

Liwei: I can reproduce locally with the same model + runtime-3.4.1-release image. Repro steps: run the exact prompt, then dump tokenizer tokens with `rwad-tokenize --model redwood-v2-small --text "\nHere is the example:\n```\nfunction example()`"`. I see token sequence: `[... 450, 322, 6010, 1007, 13]` where `6010` corresponds to a backtick token and `13` is newline. After the runtime patch `6010` is being merged with adjacent punctuation in certain contexts (token boundary shifted).

Carlos: thanks Liwei — that aligns with my quick diff of the tokenizer-config: we changed unicode normalization to `NFKC` in fc3a9 which collapses some backtick+whitespace combos. That change was meant to fix token duplication in other languages but looks like it regressed fenced-markdown emission.

Marta: P1 or P2? Customers are hitting production render issues, markdown shows bad blocks, some support tickets piling up.

Sophie: I'd call it P2 (functional regression affecting formatting) but high visibility. Action items: (1) rollback tokenizer-config change from fc3a9 to previous for hosted models, (2) create short-term SDK/server-side mitigation: post-process generation to normalize unmatched fences, (3) notify customers using redwood-v2-small and similar models.

Carlos: Rolling back fc3a9 in the rollout plan now — creating canary revert for the tokenizer-config in the next 10m. I'll also draft a hotfix to the runtime that avoids NFKC normalization for punctuation tokens.

Liwei: For immediate mitigation we can recommend customers add a stop sequence that captures the fence end explicitly: "stop": ["\n```\n", "\n```"] but that relies on customers knowing exact spacing. Better short-term: SDK layer can run a quick regex to fix unmatched fences: s/```([^`]*)$/``` 

Marta: Ryan — sorry for the disruption. We'll try the SDK patch and roll back the tokenizer change. Would you be able to enable verbose logging for a few minutes to capture token-level output (we'll send a small flag to your org to increase trace level)? That will help confirm before/after.

Ryan_Customer: Yes — we can enable verbose. Please send the flag. Also please keep us posted on ETA for rollback, customers are starting to complain in our support queue.

DeployBot: Canary revert started for `deploy_20250322_v3` component `tokenizer-config` (task id: revert_778). Estimated completion 10m.

Carlos: Revert applied to canary, monitoring results. Early signs: canary traffic for the same prompt shows normalized markdown back to expected output for 1k requests. Preparing to promote revert to full fleet if no anomalies in next 20m.

Sophie: Assigning follow-ups: `CS-8712` -> outreach to affected customers (Marta), `ENG-1934` -> rollback verification + runtime hotfix (Carlos), `ML-845` -> tokenizer test addition for fenced-code cases (Liwei). Please include test vectors with various fence/spaces/backtick combos.

Marta: Will message affected customers and share workaround (SDK regex) until fully rolled back. Also will attach sample regex for customers: `/(?:```)(?:[\s\S]*?)(?:```)/g` — use careful ungreedy matching and then verify counts of fences are even.

Carlos: Revert promoted to full fleet at 2025-03-22T09:28:45Z. Post-rollback stats: error reports dropped to baseline. Root cause summary: `NFKC` punctuation normalization in tokenizer-config (fc3a9) changed token boundaries for backticks and whitespace, breaking stop/fence alignment in some contexts. Smaller models with aggressive token merging more affected.

Liwei: Added unit tests to guard fenced-markdown outputs and a new tokenizer integration test. Will also add a regression test that runs sample payloads against runtime-3.4.x images pre/post-change.

Marta: Notifying Ryan with timeline and workaround, closing CS ticket after customer confirms. Ryan let us know if you still see anything. :pray:

Ryan_Customer: Thanks for fast turnaround. We'll keep the verbose logs on for 30m and report if anything else shows up. Appreciate the quick rollback.

Sophie: Thanks everyone. Postmortem planned (ENG-1934) — include timeline + customer impact + preventative test coverage.

Carlos: FYI I'll follow up with a small RFC to avoid broad normalization changes in tokenizer configs without dedicated punctuation test vectors.

(Reaction annotations: a few :thumbsup: and :eyes: throughout the thread)
